derived_from: E2/H5 MODEL_DENIAL (Ast B/C) + h5_unexpected_flip anomaly (Ast D): open whether denials are stable properties or one-off sampling artifacts
diagnostic_status: DESIGN ONLY - no runs, no prompt/pipeline/frozen changes
exclusion_leakage: no new sentences (6 frozen items reused verbatim); no gold changes; no candidate generation; frozen validate() only
gold_rules: reused frozen verbatim (E2/H5 YES, E1/E3-analog controls YES, F1/F2 NO); no new annotation
measurement_question: are the E2/H5 MODEL_DENIAL verdicts stable across repeated frozen-prompt runs, or one-off artifacts?
no_changes: no prompt change (frozen prompt only, both runs)
objective: replicate validator verdicts on fixed items to separate stable denials from sampling noise

preregistered_verdicts.per_item_rules: 3/3 repetitions match original -> replicated; >=1/3 deviating -> instability_detected for that item; technical/provider-comparability problems -> probe_issue for that item
preregistered_verdicts.probe_issue: technical failures or provider pool changes that prevent like-for-like comparison: report, no claim
preregistered_verdicts.probe_level_rules: all six items replicated -> replication_confirmed_under_this_setup; >=1 item unstable -> instability_detected; comparability not given -> probe_issue
preregistered_verdicts.replication_confirmed_under_this_setup: all 18 verdicts match originals: E2/H5 denials reproduced under this exact validator setup (NOT a claim of general model constancy)
preregistered_verdicts.temperature_note: temperature=0 does not guarantee determinism (provider/backend sampling variability possible); that is exactly why repetition is informative, and why a 3/3 match licenses only under-this-setup replication, never a general stability property

repetitions: 3 runs per item (18 requests); temperature 0 per frozen prompt; any flip counts regardless of repetition index
status: DESIGN FROZEN FOR REVIEW - build and run require separate approvals
trail_fields: same P1/P2 trail as V-probe (prompt_version frozen constant); provider recorded per request, provider switches reported separately, never pooled silently
